editorNote: Amazon is pushing Trainium toward PyTorch users: TorchNeuron, a native backend, was announced across the PyTorch, Hugging Face and AWS blogs. Separately, security stayed in view: a report of AI agents used to break into two companies, hackers abusing the OpenCode coding tool, and Meta chatbot instructions exposed on WhatsApp help pages.
